To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the availability of consumer credit has increased dramatically over the past 30 years, and that the increased availability of credit has led to a significant rise in consumer debt.

(1) The dramatic increase in consumer debt burden and the number of consumer bankruptcies are indicators that restrictions should be placed on the availability of non-investment consumer unsecured loans; (2) Consumer unsecured loans should be treated as a separate class of loan from business loans and should be restricted to the extent that they can be made available to consumers; (3) The pool of loan applicants for consumer unsecured loans is not homogeneous, and the pool of applicants should be treated as such.
the availability of unsecured consumer loans is harmful to the economy and to the society.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of unsecured loans on consumers.
the adverse effects of consumer loans.
consumer debt and how it affects consumers and the financial services firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the consumer debt is a social problem and that the solution is to limit its availability.
the consumer debt burden is not only harmful to consumers, but it is also harmful to society.
credit cards are an essential and convenient payment method, but that they have been misused and abused.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the negative effects of consumer loans and have argued that credit should be used only for the purchase of goods and services and not for consumption.
the consumer debt burden is a significant problem that is growing and needs to be addressed.
consumer loans should not be made available to the general public.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are many adverse effects of consumer debt that are not captured by standard measures such as the consumer bankruptcy rate.
the availability of consumer debt for the purchase of goods and services has had a negative effect on the economy and society.
the availability of consumer loans is not a good thing for society as a whole and should be restricted.
